audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Creation, human dignity, elohim, dominion, animals, sea, and cosmic praise.

verses.restored: O YHWH, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

familiar.text: O LORD, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.

verses.restored: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

familiar.text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

verses.restored: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

familiar.text: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;

verses.restored: What is humanity, that you remember them, and a human being, that you attend to them?

familiar.text: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

verses.restored: Yet you have made humanity a little lower than the divine beings [elohim], and crowned them with glory and honor.

familiar.text: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

notes.title: Elohim: God or divine beings
notes.body: Hebrew elohim can refer to God or divine beings. The Greek tradition renders “angels,” a reading later cited in Hebrews 2. The restored text keeps the Hebrew semantic range visible.

verses.restored: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

familiar.text: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:

verses.restored: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

familiar.text: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

verses.restored: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

familiar.text: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.

verses.restored: O YHWH our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

familiar.text: O LORD our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Human “dominion” is not a license for ecological exploitation, cruelty, or claims of superiority over vulnerable people.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
